117562.name: Chabad of Pacific Palisades
117562.note: Chabad.org News (Jan 2025): 'Founded in 1992, Chabad of Pacific Palisades is directed by Rabbi Zushe and Zisi Cunin'; the Forward: director 'since 1992'. The Palisades fire (Jan 2025) 'partially destroyed Chabad's campus and preschool' at 17315 Sunset Blvd. (Lubavitch.com, Aug 31 2025, 'From the Ashes: Pacific Palisades Rebuilds'); the preschool ran 'in a renovated building' meanwhile, which the state's data (May 2025) shows as a pending license for the Palisades Jewish Early Childhood Center at 1537 Franklin St., Santa Monica; the campus renovations were to be finished by the 2025 High Holidays. Its preschool had been licensed at 17311-15 W. Sunset Blvd. since May 30 2012. lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010 lists it at 15207-A Sunset Blvd., Pacific Palisades; it is now at 17315 W. Sunset Blvd., so it moved after Aug 2010 (when, not found). Its preschool has been licensed at 17311-15 W. Sunset Blvd. since May 30 2012 (California's childcare licensing, facility 197417887), so probably moved by 2012.

earlier.where: 15207-A Sunset Blvd., Pacific Palisades (its address in lubavitch.com's center directory as archived Aug 29 2010)
